info.name: OpenBSP Direct WhatsApp Webhook Test
info.description: Tests a Meta WhatsApp webhook payload directly against OpenBSP before publishing the same raw body and signature through CloudAMQP.

exec: if (!rawBody || !appSecret) throw new Error('meta_raw_body and meta_app_secret are required');
pm.test('OpenBSP accepted the HTTP request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
console.log('A 200 can also represent an ignored invalid webhook. Confirm Persisted messages in Edge Function logs.');

request.description: The body is sent exactly as stored in meta_raw_body. Use a unique WAMID and current timestamp for a synthetic staging test. Confirm persistence in the whatsapp-webhook logs.
